label: C20-T1
primary_statement: For every finite simple undirected subcubic G with E(G)=D disjoint-union U, every fixed star edge coloring c:D->{1,2,3,4}, and every family of nonempty U components that are vertex-disjoint paths of at most three edges (including the empty family), c extends using only {5,6} on U if and only if every cycle in the signed multigraph of all actual alternating D/U four-edge simple paths and four-cycles with equal D colors has sign XOR zero, where the row for U edges e in P and f in Q has sign 1 XOR p(e) XOR p(f).

semantics.path: four edges, five distinct vertices; not necessarily induced
semantics.edge_index_parity: zero-based within one fixed oriented full U component
semantics.phase: one bit per nonempty U component
semantics.row_support: all actual selected shapes retained, including multiple witnesses for one algebraic triple
semantics.signed_cycles: loops and distinct parallel-edge cycles included; sign XOR, not length parity
semantics.completion: D colors retained and U restricted to disjoint palette B={5,6}

additional_statements: Inclusion-minimal inconsistent row subsets are precisely sign-one simple cycles. Minimum cardinality equals shortest negative cycle length, counting row occurrences.
Forest propagation yields an inclusion-minimal core in O(k+m); sequential parity-cover BFS yields a minimum-cardinality core in O(k(k+m)); every returned row retains a graph witness.

If an induced matching R in D can be recolored with a spare A color and intersects the fixed edges of every support outside a chosen signed forest triple set, the modified frame has a star completion.
Contact parity constant on each U component plus a bipartite, self-row-free contact graph suffices for extension with no D change.

In a strong-four-colored perfect-matching frame, a complementary four-cycle with all four distinct matching labels and only one special edge forces a contradictory self-row; order eight is sharp for this specific class.
